versions.changelog:
- Added a "Start on APIDot" section with clear entry points for model docs, account, and examples.
- Improved navigation by grouping key APIDot model and documentation links together early in the document.
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- No changes to functional behavior; the skill remains documentation-only.

Initial release of the apidot-hailuo-2-3-api skill:

- Provides documentation and workflow guidance for integrating MiniMax Hailuo 2.3 API via APIDot.
- Supports text-to-video, image-to-video, start-image guidance, prompt optimization, duration and resolution planning, async task handling, polling, and webhooks.
- Includes non-executable notes only; no scripts, installation, or API clients are bundled.
- Emphasizes correct API key handling and links directly to APIDot docs and model pages.
- Offers practical model routing and async workflow notes, with official reference links for all endpoints.
